prompts.terrain: Create a production-oriented original 2D isometric RPG terrain TILE ATLAS for Mar de Jade, a fictional maritime adventure in 16th-century Lisbon. Crisp hand-painted pixel art, richly textured but readable at small scale, restrained outlines, warm limestone and jade sea palette. CANVAS EXACTLY 1024 wide by 512 high. Four equally sized cells in a 2-column by 2-row grid; each cell is 512x256. In EACH cell draw ONE FLAT RHOMBUS terrain tile occupying the full cell, touching the midpoint of all four edges, exact 2:1 isometric diamond. Everything outside the diamond is genuinely transparent. NO thickness, NO side walls, NO cast shadow, NO border, NO props, NO labels. Top-left: sun-warmed irregular Portuguese limestone paving with subtle cracks, tiny moss specks and restrained warm variation, no large motifs. Top-right: weathered horizontal wooden quay planks. Bottom-left: worn earthen path with sparse low green grasses. Bottom-right: dim warm timber floor for an indoor warehouse. Consistent scale and lighting from upper left. Tile content should repeat reasonably, without isolated focal objects. Original designs only; no existing game assets. This is a usable texture atlas, not a screenshot, not a concept board.
prompts.port_props: Create an original isolated SPRITE ATLAS for a 2D isometric maritime RPG set in fictional 16th-century Lisbon, with the readable, finely shaded hand-painted pixel-art craftsmanship of a classic detailed isometric RPG. Do not reproduce any existing game's assets or buildings. Canvas 1024x1024, EXACTLY four 512x512 cells in a 2 by 2 grid with generous transparent gutters. Use a consistent orthographic isometric view, 2:1 ground axes, crisp pixel edges, warm afternoon lighting from upper left, no blurry painting. Put each object's ground contact centered around x=256 y=440 within its own cell, preserve all silhouettes inside the cell and leave at least 24px clear margins. TOP LEFT: a compact Portuguese port warehouse, warm ivory limewashed walls, reddish terracotta tiled roof, dark blue-green wooden double door visible on the front-facing right wall, a tiny high window and restrained worn stone foundation. A complete freestanding building, no surrounding ground. TOP RIGHT: a weathered wooden dock crane with rope, large simple triangular frame and hand winch; no ground platform. BOTTOM LEFT: one beautiful windswept maritime pine with a crooked trunk and rounded layered foliage, small visible roots. BOTTOM RIGHT: a compact cluster of two shipping crates, one barrel and coiled rope. Truly TRANSPARENT background all cells, no checkerboard, no ground tiles, no text or UI, no contact shadow baked beyond the immediate feet, no characters. Consistent pixel density across all sprites.
prompts.traveller: Generate a precise original game character WALK CYCLE SPRITE SHEET with actual transparent background, for Mar de Jade, a 2D maritime RPG set in a fictional sixteenth-century Portuguese port. Canvas square 1024x1024 with an EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows uniform grid, each cell 256x256. No separators. Same young adult male traveller in every cell: dark brown short wavy hair, ivory linen shirt, muted deep teal short waistcoat, brown trousers and leather boots, small leather cross-body satchel. No weapons, no hat, no cape. Friendly grounded adventurous design, readable moderately chibi proportions, head not oversized; finely shaded crisp hand-painted pixel art, no blur or antialiasing. Each full body is centered at x=128 within its cell, ground contact at y=226, same apparent height about 185 pixels in every frame, generous clear gutter. Rows define orientation: row 1 SOUTH facing camera with slightly overhead RPG view; row 2 WEST facing left; row 3 NORTH back facing camera; row 4 EAST facing right. Columns: first is neutral standing idle, second left leg forward walk, third legs passing walk, fourth right leg forward walk. Same identity, clothes, lighting upper-left and exact scale throughout. The only movement across columns is natural walking limbs, never changing outfit or equipment. Genuine transparent background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no captions. This is a functional animation atlas, not a concept illustration or layout of different characters.
prompts.traveller_walk_revision: Edit the original Mar de Jade traveler atlas. Preserve the same traveler, outfit, 4x4 grid, four-direction row order, transparent background, scale, and style. Make columns 2–4 a clearly readable looping walk cycle with unmistakably alternating legs, visible arm swing, and subtle bag follow-through. Give the front and back rows equally clear movement instead of nearly frozen poses. Keep column 1 idle, baselines consistent, and add no ground, scenery, text, or extra characters.
prompts.traveller_walk_revision_2: Revise the original Mar de Jade character atlas. Preserve the same traveler, exact clothing and colors, hand-painted pixel-art look, transparent background, 4 columns x 4 rows, consistent scale, and row order. Keep the first front-facing row essentially unchanged. In the west, north/back, and east rows, make columns 2–4 show strongly different sequential walk poses with visibly separated alternating legs and boots, bent or extended feet, a passing-leg pose, opposite arm swing, and a subtle moving satchel. Make the back-facing leg motion unmistakable at small size. Keep column 1 idle, align every ground baseline, and add no floor, shadows, objects, labels, or grid lines.
